## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `ruff` / `flutter analyze` pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or large binary assets committed
- [ ] API contract changes are versioned; DB changes include a migration
- [ ] Original artwork remains immutable (new derived assets, never overwrite)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
